description: Squared Euclidean distance from each embedding to a shared fixed center, summed over embedding coordinates and reduced over examples; implements only Deep One-Class Classification §3 Eq. (4). Coordinate sum and batch mean follow src/optim/deepSVDD_trainer.py:650-663.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from topologies import Trainer, analysis, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
class EmbeddingModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.network = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=4, out_features=2)
    def forward(self, inputs):
        return {"embedding": self.network(inputs)}
model = EmbeddingModel()
with torch.no_grad():
    center = model(torch.zeros((1, 4)))["embedding"].squeeze(0)
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    inputs = torch.randn(4, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"inputs": synth.Tensor(inputs), "center": synth.Tensor(center.clone())}
dataset = synth.Spec("deepsvdd-normal-vectors", generator=samples, size=12, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="train")
val = dataset.for_recipe("structured-objective", split="val", like=train)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, val, recipe="structured-objective", recipe_config={"loss": "deepsvdd", "bindings": {"logits_or_prediction": {"output": "embedding"}, "targets": {"batch": "center"}}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
validation_metrics = trainer.evaluate(val)
report = analysis.analyze(model)
examples.title: Train embeddings against a fixed center

name: Deep SVDD One-Class Distance Loss

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; unrecognized keyword parameters raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the one-class distance equation has no ignored labels
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point embeddings shaped [B,D] with positive batch and embedding dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns per-example coordinate sums; mean averages examples; sum totals examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: finite floating-point fixed center shaped [D] or [B,D] with every row equal; dtype and device must match embeddings
